description: HIC’s Gourmet Mincer for chopping greens and fruits, mincing garlic and herbs, cutting noodles, tenderizing meat, fish, and more. With 9 stainless steel blades, it transforms ingredients in just seconds and saves time during food preparation. A versatile addition to cutlery and chef knives, this multipurpose herb mincer is great for preparing ingredients for all food choices, including low carb, paleo, gluten free, raw and vegetarian. Use it for making minced garlic and roughly chopped herbs for stir fry, vegetable soup, toppings for chopped salad, even tenderize meat and poultry more. Its easy-grip handle is comfortable to hold. So easy to use. Simply place items to be minced or tenderized onto a cutting board. Roll the blades across the items and continue until desired texture is achieved. The 9 blades are made from stainless steel. The easy-grip handle is durable and comfortable to hold. Dishwasher safe for easy cleanup.
